meta.requirement: Explore Dawn Winery (20%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: The Hikers Return
start.text:
''Same road near the winery. Same impossible packs. This time they spot you first.''

Tariq: ''adjusting a strap'' There you are. We wondered if we would cross paths again.

Lena: ''studying your shoulders'' You still have the frame. Good. We have been thinking about it since we left Mondstadt.

Thinking_about_what.text:
Tariq: The twenty kilogram frame was a solid start. But the reinforcement plates can take more load if we rebuild the junction points properly.

Lena: Forty kilograms. Same distribution. You would not feel it until you tried.

Tariq: ''opens his notebook'' One hundred Silver for the metal work. One hundred Slime Condensate for the adhesive layer. We can do it here before we move on.

I_will_get_the_materials.text:
Tariq: We will be on this stretch of road a while.

Lena: Do not take too long. We add stones tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring 100 Silver and 100 Slime Condensate to the hikers at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg and click Return to the Hikers

return.text:
''Tariq looks up from a spread of metal plates laid out on a flat stone. Lena is testing strap tension on a frame assembly.''

Tariq: Back. Did you bring them?

pack_upgraded.title: Pack Upgraded
pack_upgraded.text:
''Lena takes the Condensate first and checks the consistency. Tariq counts the Silver, then sets to work on the frame without another word.''

''It does not take long. New plates at every junction, fresh adhesive on every strap termination, the load rails widened by a careful half inch.''

Tariq: There. Forty kilograms. Try not to fill it all at once.

Lena: ''already shouldering her pack'' You will anyway.

Tariq: Safe travels. ''a brief nod'' Perhaps we will see you on the road again.

still_gethrr.text:
Tariq: ''nods'' No rush. The road will still be here.

''Lena goes back to the frame without looking up.''
